requirements_implemented: literal-only permit writes: 'pin write PC.23 low|high'; IO70 read-only; non-whitelist command throws at the send layer
full RX stream (rx_full.txt) kept separately from selected replies (command_trace.txt); bytes arriving at open are stored, never used as a reply
query INVALID/NO_REPLY on: echo-only, timeout, conflicting duplicates, 'command not found', 'Parameter invalid', boot banner; serial exceptions not swallowed
cleanup decision requires IO87=low AND IO70=high jointly; at most one extra LOW; otherwise FINAL_STATE_UNKNOWN with non-zero rc
monotonic host budget decoupled from level matching; on overrun the window breaks, literal LOW goes first, no further HIGH, and rc is non-zero (not just a log line)
any attempted HIGH path reaches LOW via finally; rc=0 only when everything passed
fresh run id and refusal to overwrite existing output; no rm -rf, no background retry

cases: baseline anomaly must send literal PC.23 and never HIGH
cut observed with two adjacent samples
budget spent skips window and cleans up

what_this_proves: 在本次 e40 固件与当前装配/供电下：实际许可仍为 HIGH 时，操作已安装的 SW1 使 IO70 在同一连续 HIGH 窗口内由 LOW 变 HIGH（硬件链被急停侧阻断），随后撤许可成功
实测确定 SW1 的 2-3 为允许侧、1-2 为阻断侧（与图纸标注的 pin 角色相反，已记冲突）
what_this_does_not_prove: ANALOG_NOT_VERIFIED / METER_NOT_MEASURED_THIS_RUN: 本轮无任何仪表读数；U13/U5/Q1 栅/H6-5 的实际电压、逻辑电平是否落在 Rev.1.09 阈值内均未验证
